recap.text: Tempest, a young Nullian and niece of Quasar, trades plumbing repairs for an interview with Carl and Donut for a school report. She threatens to tell her father that Quasar claimed to be her real dad to improve the terms. She records details about the dog girl with the flamethrower and the spider in Carl's chest before she asks if Quasar is in danger for representing Carl.

Quasar sees a tablet feed of his niece, Tempest, with blood on her temple. A Taurin tells Quasar that his brother and Tempest are in danger because the Taurin took a contract with Quasar's client's wife. Tempest kills the Taurins with an illegal blaster and asks if they are all gone. Quasar hires Kiki for one credit to provide legal help and the other kind.

beats.headline: A sink for a recap
beats.text: For the record: Tempest is Quasar's niece, a young Nullian with a school report due on perceptions of the crawl, and she has been assigned Carl and Donut, because her teacher knows who her uncle is. Most people she interviews give their answers for free. He does not. The trade is that she fixes his plumbing, of which she knows nothing. She informs him that the only lesson she has learned today is that her uncle is a colossal prick, and tells him to start talking.
beats.gist: Tempest is Quasar's niece and a Nullian student who trades plumbing repairs for Carl's interview.

beats.headline: Terms, and a recap
beats.text: His opening recap is three sentences, the last of them The end. Terms improve when she threatens to tell her father that Quasar claimed to be her real dad: now we're talking, says her uncle. She records the eighth floor from him, cards, Quan, the dog girl with the flamethrower, the nun, and presses on what he skips: the homeless shelter, the last card, the spider in Carl's chest. The pipe comes away in her hands. Don't worry, kid, he says. The sink doesn't work anyway. It's an art piece.
beats.gist: Tempest threatens to tell her father that Quasar claimed to be her real dad.

beats.headline: Are you in danger?
beats.text: She turns the recorder off before she asks the serious question. Is he in danger for representing Carl? Real danger? Quasar wants to lie and decides against it; the kid deserves the truth. He thinks they all are, he tells her. It is the first time in his life he is glad they live so far out in the middle of nowhere. Filed without comment, beyond this: she asked it with the recorder off.
beats.gist: Tempest turns off the recorder and asks Quasar if representing Carl is real danger.

beats.headline: Blood at her temple
beats.text: Her uncle is heading for a tunnel booth when his tablet shows her face, panicked, blood on her temple. Taurins came looking for Quasar; her dad told them to fuck themselves, and he is hurt. A voice finds her off screen, she shrieks, and the feed goes fuzzy. Then a Taurin's head fills the screen, apologetic. He took a contract with Quasar's client's wife. Quasar can come to him, and his brother and this sweet little piece of Nullian ass need not get hurt.
beats.gist: Quasar sees a panicked Tempest with blood on her temple on his tablet.

beats.headline: The illegal blaster
beats.text: The Taurin's head explodes. So does the second one's. Tempest comes back on screen crying, holding the blaster her uncle gave her, very illegal, already tagged by law enforcement sniffers until Quasar flags the call as attorney business. Is that all of them? She thinks so. He tells her to check on her dad and go with the someone he is sending to the house. Her dad, she reports, is screaming, more mad than hurt. Quasar hires Kiki for one credit: legal help, and the other kind.
beats.gist: Tempest explodes two Taurin heads with an illegal blaster and Quasar hires Kiki for one credit.
